name: ditto-kotlin
description: Ditto Kotlin SDK assistance — Android and JVM apps: Gradle setup, connecting, authentication, transports, subscriptions, DQL execution, observers with coroutines/Flow, attachments, presence, and testing. Covers Ditto SDK 4.14.x (LTS), 5.0.x, and 5.1.x

interface.shortDescription: Integrate and troubleshoot the Ditto Kotlin SDK on Android and the JVM.
defaultPrompt: Integrate Ditto into this Android app with a ViewModel-backed observer.
Generate a runnable Gradle project that syncs a collection with Ditto.
Diagnose why my Kotlin store observer stopped delivering updates.
